details:
So I used a few mods and I would like to request a few to be added
I am a hh user, you guys have this feature where voice audio drops off the farther someone is. I used a mod to make this feature work in a bigger radius/drop off slower. I also used another mod to amplify the in game audio cause when I use 3rd party software, it introduces clipping in the audio. (Closed captions support would be nice too)
I have a friend who is visually blind so magnification options would be cool, He used mods that gave him a magnified glass but you all removed mods so rip.
Another request I would like is join notifications, sorta like discord, and shows who joined in the corner of my screen.
last I want portal confirmations. before going into a portal, it should ask me if it is what I want to do, there is a glitch where you can put portals on people and people were doing this all day yesterday in public lobbies, that or crashing them.
Honorable mentions. I want a mod that automatically disabled avatars that are far away from me, and I would like to be able to change these settings.
title: I would like a few features added to the game
